prompt:

Use attached character art ONLY for the golden Eastern dragon design and black/ivory/antique-gold aesthetic. No human, no character, no costume, no sword object, no background, no landscape, no UI or text. Do not draw a checkerboard or black rectangle. Soft semi-transparent gold embers/glows must have genuine alpha.
EXACT GRID: FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE cells, chronological left-to-right top-to-bottom. Canvas 2048x1536 preferred, equal square cells. Each cell contains one complete separate animation frame in its own space with at least 8% transparent empty margin, no overlap across cells, no grid lines or labels. Fixed camera and fixed effect-origin center in every cell. The action evolves in shape, not simply an identical icon enlarged or rotated. Ornate refined filmic gold and molten ivory highlights, bronze-gold carved-scale detail, luminous filaments, dimensional smoke wisps, golden sparks, intentional value separation instead of blown-out white blobs. Match the reference's antlered wingless Eastern dragon with long whiskers, pointed cheek spines and distinctive snout when a dragon is present.
ANIMATION: TWELVE-FRAME DRAGON STRIKE evolving in place toward SCREEN RIGHT: 1 tightly coiled small golden dragon spirit condenses; 2-3 head unfolds with antler horns, whiskers and detailed gold scales; 4-5 serpentine body uncoils and head lunges fiercely right with open jaws; 6-7 full striking pose: large unmistakable Eastern dragon head leading, S-curved gilded spine and torso trailing left, intense pale gold mouth/core glow, graceful razor whiskers; 8-9 body dissolves backward into flowing gold fire and individual shining scales; 10-12 residual spectral head then fine curling sparks disperse. SAME ONE dragon identity matching reference, wingless no legs needed, not a western dragon; frame-specific anatomy evolution not a row of icons.
